scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/shared test && bun run --cwd legacy/web test
scripts.setup:chatterbox: python3.11 -m venv tools/export/.venv-chatterbox && tools/export/.venv-chatterbox/bin/pip install -q --upgrade pip && tools/export/.venv-chatterbox/bin/pip install -q -r tools/export/requirements.txt && tools/export/.venv-chatterbox/bin/pip install -q --force-reinstall --no-deps -r tools/export/requirements.txt
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit -p legacy/web && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared
scripts.kit:test: cd packages/huiverkit && swift build --build-tests && (cp ../../apps/mac/mlx.metallib .build/arm64-apple-macosx/debug/HuiverKitPackageTests.xctest/Contents/MacOS/ 2>/dev/null || true) && swift test
scripts.ios:build: xcodebuild -project apps/ios/Huiver.xcodeproj -scheme Huiver -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -configuration Debug build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.mac:build: xcodebuild -project apps/mac/Huiver.xcodeproj -scheme Huiver -configuration Debug build -allowProvisioningUpdates -skipPackagePluginValidation -derivedDataPath apps/mac/DerivedData
scripts.mac:build:adhoc: xcodebuild -project apps/mac/Huiver.xcodeproj -scheme Huiver -configuration Debug build -skipPackagePluginValidation -derivedDataPath apps/mac/DerivedData CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=
